story.fullStory:
Frank And Nancy Sinatra's "Something Stupid" — original release 1966. "Somethin' Stupid", or "Something Stupid", is a song written by C.

It was originally recorded in 1966 by Parks and his wife Gaile Foote, as Carson and Gaile.

A 1967 version by Frank Sinatra and his daughter Nancy Sinatra became a major international hit, reaching number one on both the Billboard Hot 100 chart and the UK Singles Chart.

This article presents the discography of American pop singer Nancy Sinatra.
